fb_feed.text:
I run a commercial plant service in Atlanta — 50+ corporate and commercial properties in the Metro Atlanta area.

My phone used to ring all day. Gate codes. "Did we finish the atrium?" "Where do we park at the Riverside office?" Every answer lived in my head, so every question came to me.

I got tired of being the help desk for my own company. So I built the thing I needed: my crew texts their notes like they already do, and every gate code, access note, and visit detail becomes searchable company knowledge.

Now my new guy asks the bot, not me. He hasn't called me in weeks.

FieldNotes. I built it for my own business first.
